hp_descriptions.Aberforth Dumbledore: First pictured as a boy alongside Albus in matching lacy-collared jackets with identical shoulder-length hair. When met in person at the Hog's Head, he is described as a tall old man (as tall as Albus) with a wrangled beard, glasses whose lenses reflect the firelight, and eyes extraordinarily like his brother's.
hp_descriptions.Alastor Moody: Shrouded in a black traveling cloak with a long mane of grizzled, dark gray hair. His face looks carved out of weathered wood by an unskilled chisel, covered in scars, with a mouth like a diagonal gash and a large chunk of his nose missing. He has one small, dark, beady eye and a large, round, electric-blue magical eye that rolls ceaselessly, plus a carved wooden leg ending in a clawed foot.
hp_descriptions.Albus Percival Wulfric Brian Dumbledore: A tall, thin, and very old wizard with silver hair and beard long enough to tuck into his belt. He wears long robes, a ground-sweeping purple cloak, high-heeled buckled boots, half-moon spectacles over bright blue sparkling eyes, and a very long, crooked nose.
hp_descriptions.Alecto Carrow: A stocky, sloping-shouldered, and short Death Eater with a stubby forefinger and an angry, jeering titter.
hp_descriptions.Alice Longbottom: First seen in a photograph as having a round, friendly face; in St. Mungo's, her face is thin and worn, her eyes seem overlarge, and her white hair is wispy and dead-looking.
hp_descriptions.Amos Diggory: A ruddy-faced wizard with a scrubby brown beard.
hp_descriptions.Amycus Carrow: A big, rangy, lumpy Death Eater with an uncouth voice, a hunched posture, a pallid doughy face, and tiny eyes.
hp_descriptions.Andromeda Tonks: A witch resembling her sister Bellatrix, but with light, soft brown hair and wider, kinder eyes, though retaining a slightly haughty expression.
hp_descriptions.Angelina Johnson: A tall black girl with long braided hair who plays Chaser on the Gryffindor Quidditch team.
hp_descriptions.Arabella Doreen Figg: A batty old neighbor with grizzled gray hair escaping from her hairnet, wearing tartan carpet slippers and carrying a clanking string shopping bag full of cat food.
hp_descriptions.Argus Filch: The Hogwarts caretaker, a pouchy-faced, wheezing, hunchbacked man with a bulbous purple nose that constantly drips, popping eyes, and aquiver jowls.
hp_descriptions.Ariana Dumbledore: Pictured as a newborn baby little longer than a loaf of bread; remembered by others as a delicate, frail, sweet, and scared girl.
hp_descriptions.Arthur Weasley: A thin man going bald, with what little hair he has being as red as his children's, wearing horn-rimmed glasses and dusty, travel-worn robes.
hp_descriptions.Aurora Sinistra: A tall witch with dark hair, often seen wearing dark robes and an astronomical hat, moving with a quiet, mysterious elegance.
hp_descriptions.Bartemius Crouch Junior: First seen in Dumbledore's Pensieve as a petrified boy in his late teens, shivering with milk-white freckled skin and straw-colored hair over his face; later unmasked as pale-skinned with a mop of fair hair.
hp_descriptions.Bartemius Crouch Senior: A stiff, upright, elderly man dressed in an impeccably crisp suit and tie, with unnaturally straight-parted short gray hair, a narrow toothbrush mustache trimmed as if with a slide rule, and highly polished shoes.
hp_descriptions.Bathilda Bagshot: A tiny old woman, bowed down with age and barely reaching level with Harry's chest, with eyes thick with cataracts, skin full of broken veins and liver spots, and scant white hair through which her scalp shows.
hp_descriptions.Bellatrix Lestrange: A dark woman with long, thick dark hair, heavily lidded eyes, a strong jaw, an arrogant, disdainful smile, and a gaunt, skull-like face from her time in Azkaban.
hp_descriptions.Blaise Zabini: A tall, dark Slytherin boy with high cheekbones, slanting dark eyes, and a haughty, contemptuous expression.
hp_descriptions.Cedric Diggory: An extremely handsome seventeen-year-old boy with a straight nose, dark hair, and gray eyes.
hp_descriptions.Charlie Weasley: Shorter and stockier than Percy and Ron, with a broad, good-natured, weather-beaten, freckled face and muscular arms covered in burns and scratches.
hp_descriptions.Cho Chang: A very pretty girl shorter than Harry by about a head, with long, shiny black hair.
hp_descriptions.Colin Creevey: A very small first-year Gryffindor boy who is breathlessly excited and constantly carries a large black camera.
hp_descriptions.Corban Yaxley: A Death Eater with blunt, scowling, slightly brutish features and long black hair and beard streaked with silver.
hp_descriptions.Cormac McLaggen: A large, wiry-haired, broad youth with a swaggering demeanor.
hp_descriptions.Cornelius Oswald Fudge: A portly, anxious-looking man with rumpled gray hair, wearing a pinstriped suit, scarlet tie, long black cloak, pointed purple boots, and a lime-green bowler hat.
hp_descriptions.Dean Thomas: A tall black boy in Harry's year at Hogwarts.
hp_descriptions.Dedalus Diggle: An excitable, wheezy-voiced little wizard with silver hair who wears a top hat that he frequently drops.
hp_descriptions.Dennis Creevey: The smallest of his first-year class, with mousy hair, wrapped in Hagrid's moleskin overcoat like a furry black circus tent.
hp_descriptions.Dobby: A small house-elf with large, bat-like ears, bulging green eyes the size of tennis balls, and a long, pencil-shaped nose, initially wearing a filthy old pillowcase.
hp_descriptions.Dolores Jane Umbridge: A squat woman resembling a large pale toad, with a broad, flabby face, almost no neck, a wide slack mouth, large round bulging eyes, wearing a fluffy pink cardigan and a small black velvet bow perched on her short curly hair.
hp_descriptions.Draco Lucius Malfoy: A boy with a pale, pointed face, sleek white-blond hair, and light gray eyes.
hp_descriptions.Dudley Dursley: A large, blond, pink, and porky boy with a large face, very little neck, small watery blue eyes, and thick blond hair lying smoothly on his fat head ("like a pig in a wig").
hp_descriptions.Fenrir Greyback: A big, rangy werewolf with matted gray hair and whiskers, filthy hands with long yellowish nails, a rasping bark of a voice, and an odor of dirt, sweat, and blood.
hp_descriptions.Filius Flitwick: A tiny little wizard with a shock of white hair who must stand on a stack of books to see over his desk.
hp_descriptions.Firenze: A centaur with white-blond hair, a palomino horse body, and astonishingly blue eyes like pale sapphires.
hp_descriptions.Fleur Isabelle Delacour: A breathtakingly beautiful girl with a long sheet of silvery-blonde hair down to her waist, large deep blue eyes, and very white, even teeth.
hp_descriptions.Florean Fortescue: A cheerful, welcoming man who runs the ice cream parlor, always ready with historical facts and free sundaes.
hp_descriptions.Frank Longbottom: Similar to his wife, seen in memories as a brave Auror but later physically reduced, pale, and institutionalized by tragedy.
hp_descriptions.Fred Weasley: A tall, gangling, freckled boy with flaming red hair, one half of a pair of identical prankster twins (the one who keeps both ears).
hp_descriptions.Garrick Ollivander: An old wandmaker with wide, pale eyes shining like moons through the gloom of his shop.
hp_descriptions.Gellert Grindelwald: Described in his youth as a boy with shoulder-length golden curls and a gleeful, wild look; in old age, a skeletal figure in a cell.
hp_descriptions.George Weasley: A tall, gangling, freckled boy with flaming red hair, one half of a pair of identical prankster twins (the one who later loses an ear).
hp_descriptions.Gilderoy Lockhart: A remarkably handsome wizard with wavy golden hair, bright blue eyes, pointed wizard's hat set at a jaunty angle, and dazzlingly white teeth.
hp_descriptions.Ginevra Molly Weasley: A small girl with bright, vivid red hair and freckles.
hp_descriptions.Godric Gryffindor: Historically depicted as a tall, muscular, and bold man with a roaring, fiery red mane and beard.
hp_descriptions.Gregory Goyle: A thickset, mean-looking boy with short, bristly hair and long gorilla-ish arms, acting as Draco's bodyguard.
hp_descriptions.Hannah Abbott: A pink-faced first-year girl with blonde pigtails.
hp_descriptions.Harry James Potter: A small, skinny boy for his age with a thin face, knobbly knees, bright green eyes, untidy jet-black hair, round taped glasses, and a thin, lightning-shaped scar on his forehead.
hp_descriptions.Helena Ravenclaw: A beautiful ghost with waist-length hair and a floor-length cloak, who carries herself with a proud, haughty demeanor.
hp_descriptions.Helga Hufflepuff: Historically shown as a plump, welcoming, and warm witch with a cheerful, maternal demeanor.
hp_descriptions.Hepzibah Smith: An immensely fat old lady wearing an elaborate ginger wig and brilliant pink robes, with tiny eyes fixed upon treasures.
hp_descriptions.Hermione Jean Granger: A girl with a bossy voice, lots of bushy brown hair, and rather large front teeth.
hp_descriptions.Horace Eugene Flaccus Slughorn: An enormously fat, bald old man with a shiny pate, prominent eyes, a vast walrus-like mustache, and a maroon velvet jacket over lilac silk pajamas.
hp_descriptions.Igor Karkaroff: A tall, thin man with short white hair, a goatee ending in a small curl, yellow teeth, and shrewd, cold blue eyes, wearing sleek silver furs.
hp_descriptions.Irma Pince: The Hogwarts librarian, described as a skinny, vulture-like woman.
hp_descriptions.James Potter: A tall, thin man with hazel eyes, untidy black hair sticking up at the back, and lopsided glasses, remarkably identical to Harry except for his eyes.
hp_descriptions.Katie Bell: A friendly, athletic Gryffindor Chaser with an earnest and brave demeanor.
hp_descriptions.Kingsley Shacklebolt: A tall, bald black wizard with a deep, slow voice and a single gold hoop earring.
hp_descriptions.Kreacher: A tiny, ancient house-elf with pale skin hanging in folds, white hair sprouting from batlike ears, bloodshot gray eyes, and a large, snoutlike nose, wearing a grimy loincloth.
hp_descriptions.Lavender Brown: A giggly, dramatic girl with an affinity for astrology and bright, fashionable clothes.
hp_descriptions.Lee Jordan: A Gryffindor student with dreadlocks, close friend of the Weasley twins.
hp_descriptions.Leta Lestrange: A striking, dark-haired witch with a complex, shadowed expression, carrying an aura of both aristocratic pride and deep guilt.
hp_descriptions.Lily J. Potter: A very pretty woman with dark red hair and bright green, almond-shaped eyes.
hp_descriptions.Lord Voldemort: As a soul attached to Quirrell, a chalk-white face with glaring red eyes and snake-like nostrils; upon resurrection, a figure whiter than a skull with red eyes, flat nose with slits, and long, thin white fingers. As young Tom Riddle at eleven, a tall, handsome, dark-haired, pale boy.
hp_descriptions.Lucius Malfoy: A wizard with a cold, pale, pointed face and sleek white-blond hair.
hp_descriptions.Ludovic Bagman: A powerfully built man gone to seed with a large belly, squashed nose, round blue eyes, short blond hair, and rosy complexion, wearing yellow-and-black striped Quidditch robes.
hp_descriptions.Luna Lovegood: A girl with straggly, waist-length dirty-blonde hair, pale eyebrows, protuberant eyes that give her a permanently surprised look, carrying a wand behind her ear and wearing a butterbeer-cork necklace.
hp_descriptions.Madam Hooch: The Hogwarts flying instructor, a short, yellow-eyed witch with spiky gray hair.
hp_descriptions.Madame Rosmerta: The pretty landlady of the Three Broomsticks pub in Hogsmeade.
hp_descriptions.Marietta Edgecombe: Cho's friend with curly hair and a sour expression, later disfigured with purple pustules across her face spelling "SNEAK".
hp_descriptions.Marvolo Gaunt: An elderly, oddly proportioned man with very broad shoulders, overlong arms, bright brown eyes, short scrubby hair, and a wrinkled face like an aged monkey.
hp_descriptions.Minerva McGonagall: A severe-looking witch with square glasses matching the markings around her eyes, an emerald cloak, and black hair drawn into a tight bun.
hp_descriptions.Molly Weasley: A short, plump, kind-faced woman with vivid red hair.
hp_descriptions.Mundungus Fletcher: A squat, unshaven man with short bandy legs, long straggly ginger hair, and bloodshot baggy eyes like a basset hound, smelling of stale alcohol and tobacco.
hp_descriptions.Myrtle Elizabeth Warren: The glum ghost of a squat girl with lank hair and thick, pearly spectacles.
hp_descriptions.Narcissa Malfoy: A tall, slim, pale woman with long blonde hair, who would be attractive if not for an expression like she had something smelly under her nose.
hp_descriptions.Newton Scamander: A tall, thin, and slightly awkward wizard with messy reddish-brown hair and an introverted, gentle manner, always wearing his blue coat.
hp_descriptions.Nicolas Flamel: Mentioned on Dumbledore's Chocolate Frog card as an aged alchemist.
hp_descriptions.Nymphadora Tonks: A young witch with a pale, heart-shaped face, dark twinkling eyes, and short spiky hair in vivid shades such as violet or bubble-gum pink.
hp_descriptions.Oliver Wood: A burly, passionate Gryffindor Quidditch Captain and Keeper.
hp_descriptions.Olympe Maxime: An immensely large woman (matching Hagrid's height) with an olive-skinned face, large black liquid eyes, a beaky nose, and hair in a shining knob at her neck, dressed in black satin.
hp_descriptions.Padma Patil: A pretty Ravenclaw girl with long dark hair, one of a pair of identical twins sorted into different houses.
hp_descriptions.Parvati Patil: A Gryffindor girl with long dark hair/braids.
hp_descriptions.Peeves: A poltergeist appearing as a little man with wicked dark eyes, a wide mouth, bright orange party hat, revolving bow tie, and a broad grin.
hp_descriptions.Percy Ignatius Weasley: A tall, thin, horn-rimmed-spectacled Gryffindor prefect with bright red hair and a severe, rule-abiding manner.
hp_descriptions.Peter Pettigrew: A very short man with thin, colorless, unkempt hair, a bald patch, grubby skin, a rat-like pointed nose, and small watery eyes.
hp_descriptions.Petunia Dursley: A thin, bony woman with a horse-like face and nearly twice the usual amount of neck.
hp_descriptions.Phineas Nigellus Black: A clever-looking portrait wizard with a pointed beard, dressed in green and silver.
hp_descriptions.Pomona Sprout: A squat little Herbology witch with flyaway hair under a patched hat, usually with earth on her clothes.
hp_descriptions.Poppy Pomfrey: The stern yet caring Hogwarts hospital matron.
hp_descriptions.Porpentina Esther Goldstein: A practical, grounded American witch with dark hair, sharp features, and an authoritative but compassionate posture.
hp_descriptions.Professor Binns: An ancient, shriveled ghost teacher who leaves his body in the staff room to teach History of Magic.
hp_descriptions.Quirinus Quirrell: A pale, stuttering, extremely nervous young teacher who wears a large purple turban.
hp_descriptions.Regulus Black: Pictured as a boy with dark hair and the same slightly haughty look as Sirius, but smaller, slighter, and less handsome.
hp_descriptions.Remus John Lupin: A pale, exhausted-looking man in extremely shabby, darned wizard's robes with light brown hair flecked with gray.
hp_descriptions.Rita Skeeter: A woman with rigid, elaborate curls, a heavy-jawed face, jeweled glasses, magenta robes, a crocodile-skin handbag, and two-inch crimson-painted nails.
hp_descriptions.Ronald Bilius Weasley: A tall, thin, gangling boy with freckles, big hands and feet, a long nose, and bright red hair.
hp_descriptions.Rowena Ravenclaw: Celebrated founder of a Hogwarts house; depicted in a marble statue as an austere, beautiful witch.
hp_descriptions.Rubeus Hagrid: A man almost twice as tall as a normal man and five times as wide, with long tangles of bushy black hair and beard hiding his face, beetle-black eyes, hands the size of trash-can lids, and feet like baby dolphins.
hp_descriptions.Rufus Scrimgeour: A wizard resembling an old lion, with streaks of gray in his mane of tawny hair and bushy eyebrows, keen yellowish eyes behind wire-rimmed spectacles, and a slight limp.
hp_descriptions.Salazar Slytherin: Celebrated founder whose statue in the Chamber of Secrets depicts an ancient, monkeyish face with a long, thin beard.
hp_descriptions.Seamus Finnigan: A sandy-haired Gryffindor boy in Harry's year.
hp_descriptions.Severus Snape: A thin man with sallow skin, a hooked nose, long greasy black hair falling in curtains around his face, cold dark eyes, and sweeping black robes.
hp_descriptions.Sir Nicholas de Mimsy-Porpington: A translucent ghost wearing a dashing plumed hat and a tunic with a ruff concealing his nearly severed neck.
hp_descriptions.Sirius Black: A man with a gaunt face surrounded by a matted, elbow-length tangle of hair and waxy white skin with sunken dark eyes; in his youth, tall, handsome, and gracefully built.
hp_descriptions.Stanley Shunpike: The Knight Bus conductor, an eighteen- or nineteen-year-old youth with large protruding ears and numerous pimples.
hp_descriptions.Sybill Patricia Trelawney: A very thin woman draped in a gauzy spangled shawl, wearing huge glasses that magnify her eyes to several times their size, with innumerable beads, chains, and bangles.
hp_descriptions.Theodore Nott: A thin, sly-looking Slytherin boy in Harry's year.
hp_descriptions.Vernon Dursley: A large, beefy, neckless man with a huge black mustache and small piggy eyes.
hp_descriptions.Viktor Krum: A thin, dark, sallow-skinned eighteen-year-old with a large curved nose, thick black eyebrows, an overgrown bird-of-prey look, a duck-footed gait, and round shoulders.
hp_descriptions.Vincent Crabbe: A thickset, mean-looking boy with a pudding-bowl haircut, acting as Draco's bodyguard.
hp_descriptions.William Arthur Weasley: A tall young wizard with long red hair tied back in a ponytail, a fang earring, dragon-hide boots, and a cool appearance.
hp_descriptions.Winky: A tiny house-elf with enormous brown eyes, a nose shaped like a large tomato, and a teeny quivering voice, wearing a tea towel draped like a toga.
hp_descriptions.Xenophilius Lovegood: A slightly cross-eyed wizard with shoulder-length white hair the texture of candyfloss, a cap with a dangling tassel, egg-yolk yellow robes, and a golden chain with a triangular eye symbol.
hp_descriptions.Zacharias Smith: A tall, snobbish Hufflepuff Quidditch player.

hp_locations.Hogwarts: A massive, ancient, and breathtaking Scottish fortress perched on a cliff above a vast lake, teeming with high towers, turrets, moving staircases, and hidden passageways.
hp_locations.The Burrow: A chaotic, architectural marvel of a multi-story home, visibly held up by magic, sporting red roofs, cluttered chimneys, and an overwhelming atmosphere of warmth and homeliness.
hp_locations.Diagon Alley: A hidden, bustling, cobblestone shopping street in London, packed tight with bizarre and magical shopfronts selling everything from glowing cauldrons to shrieking toads.
hp_locations.Twelve Grimmauld Place: A dismal, magically hidden London townhouse that looks neglected and decaying, filled with dark wood, dusty velvet curtains, and the gloomy, oppressive history of the Black family.
hp_locations.The Ministry of Magic: A sprawling, subterranean complex beneath London lined with dark wood and magical tiles, centered around a massive Atrium featuring glowing fireplaces and golden statues.
hp_locations.Hogsmeade: A picturesque, entirely magical village of thatched cottages and bustling shops like Honeydukes and The Three Broomsticks, completely snow-covered in the winter.
hp_locations.Azkaban: A towering, pitch-black triangular fortress set on a tiny island in the middle of a freezing, turbulent sea, radiating misery and despair from the Dementors guarding it.
hp_locations.Malfoy Manor: An elegant but chilling aristocratic estate featuring high wrought-iron gates, perfectly manicured grounds with albino peacocks, and dark, echoing, grandiose interiors.
hp_locations.Number Four, Privet Drive: A perfectly ordinary, completely indistinguishable, and aggressively mundane suburban house in Little Whinging, impeccably clean and utterly devoid of magic.
hp_locations.Godric's Hollow: A quaint, historical West Country village featuring a cozy square, a memorial statue disguised to Muggles, and the overgrown, ruined cottage where the Potters once lived.
